title: Deployment ops sync and change annotations
body:
Meeting: Deployment Ops Sync (weekly) - notes, decisions, and action items
Date: 2026-03-11 10:00 PT
Facilitator: Asha Patel
Attendees: Asha, Diego, Claire, Omar, Lina, Samir (observability), Priya (SRE on-call)

Purpose:
- Align on upcoming release windows, surface high-risk changes, and annotate change log entries with mitigation plans and telemetry gates.
- Triage two in-flight hotfix candidates and decide canary rollout strategy for next release.

Quick status snapshot:
- Deploy window for sprint v1.32: Tue 2026-03-16 01:00-03:00 UTC (primary region), staggered across regions.
- Current hotfix candidates: HF-341 (kv-cache eviction edge bug), HF-342 (metrics emitter backlog causing dropped traces).
- Canary budget: 2% traffic or 5 hosts (whichever triggers first).
- Telemetry gate baseline: 15m aggregated latency p50/p95, error spike threshold +200% over baseline, embedding failure >0.5%

Agenda items + notes:
1) HF-341 (kv-cache eviction)
   - Reporter: Claire. Repro in staging: kernel-friendly sequence length + prefetch triggered double-free path on quantized kernels (rare).
   - Impact: potential OOM/worker crash under heavy short-sequence workload (search reranking). Seen ~3 incidents in prod last 72h, small traffic subset.
   - Mitigation plan: revert recently landed kernel change (PR 983) on canary hosts, add runtime flag to disable prefetch, increase eviction guard window.
   - Decision: immediate canary patch in pre-prod; target HF release Tue night if no regression. No full rollback yet.
   - Action: Claire to ship HF branch and coordinate with Release Ops (Omar) to roll to canary subset. Owner: Claire. Due: 2026-03-12 11:00 PT.

2) HF-342 (metrics emitter backlog)
   - Reporter: Samir. Symptoms: emitter backlog spikes when pod restarts align with high ingestion bursts causing traces dropped. Correlates with sidecar restart pattern.
   - Root cause hypothesis: backpressure not propagated to upstream batching queue; sidecar flush logic races with graceful shutdown.
   - Decision: backport graceful shutdown guard and increase emitter buffer. Deploy as patch to canaries only.
   - Action: Samir to open backport PR and add unit test for sidecar shutdown race. Owner: Samir. Due: 2026-03-13 EOD PT.

3) Canary gating and telemetry annotations
   - New: add change-annotation label to each deploy entry with explicit telemetry checks and rollback policy. Example annotation: "annot:telemetry_gate=latency_p95:+25%_or_error_rate:+0.5%_for_15m => rollback"
   - Agreed: include the following checks for all canaries this cycle: p50,p95 latency; 5xx error rate; embeddings success rate; CPU steal and GPU memory pressure; cost-per-token delta (approx).
   - Action: Priya to add alerting rules to the canary monitoring dashboard and set automated rollback hook for threshold breaches. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-03-14 09:00 PT.

4) Change log hygiene and microservice impact annotations
   - Diego proposed a short template for each change entry: "summary | services affected | risk level (low/med/high) | telemetry gates | rollback step | owner".
   - Example entry (for HF-341): "kv-cache eviction fix | serving-runtime, prefetcher | high | latency_p95:+20%/oom > 1 => rollback | rollback PR available | Claire"
   - Decision: adopt template; changes without full template will be flagged in intake and blocked from canary.
   - Action: Diego to push a change-intake checklist to the release Confluence page and link it in the deploy pipeline. Owner: Diego. Due: 2026-03-13.

5) Capacity & slot allocation for next week
   - Concern: Dedicated pools in us-west-2 show elevated queueing during 00:00-02:30 UTC due to nightly batch jobs; may interfere with canary hosts.
   - Short-term: reserve 8 extra burst slots for canary hosts during the release window. Omar to coordinate with infra to provision. Due: 2026-03-15. Owner: Omar.

6) Post-deploy verification checklist updates
   - Add a quick smoke test for embedding fidelity (small prompt set) to run automatically post-canary deployment. CLI script: ./tools/smoke/embedding-fidelity.sh (Claire will add).
   - Add a quick KV-sanity check to ensure no eviction anomalies after patch. Owner: Claire. Due: 2026-03-14.

7) Outstanding risks / unresolved questions
   - Q: Is the automated rollback hook allowed for minor latency regressions during low-traffic windows? We agreed to keep conservative and allow human override only when regression is <10% and business-critical tests pass.
   - Q: Do we need to version-stamp the runtime kernels in the rollout metadata? Action: Asha to propose a metadata field in deploy manifests (kernel_version) to be included in the canary report. Due: 2026-03-16.

8) Retrospective note from last week (follow-up)
   - Found that one of the canary graphs was missing percentile aggregation due to bad tag; fixed. Lesson: include explicit aggregation sanity in onboarding docs.
   - Owner: Lina to update onboarding doc for release engineers. Due: 2026-03-18.

Decisions summary:
- HF-341: patch and canary roll; rollback PR prepared; proceed to full release if canary stable 24h with no OOM.
- HF-342: backport emitter fixes to canary; monitor trace loss metric; auto-rollback on >0.5% trace loss.
- Change-intake template mandated for canary candidates.
- Reserve burst capacity for canary hosts in us-west-2 during release window.

Action items (short):
- Claire: ship HF-341 branch, coordinate canary (due 2026-03-12 11:00 PT).
- Samir: open backport PR for emitter and add test (due 2026-03-13 EOD PT).
- Priya: configure telemetry gates and rollback hooks (due 2026-03-14 09:00 PT).
- Diego: push change-intake checklist and template to Confluence (due 2026-03-13).
- Omar: reserve 8 burst slots in us-west-2 and confirm (due 2026-03-15).
- Asha: propose kernel_version field for deploy manifests (due 2026-03-16).
- Lina: update release eng onboarding doc (due 2026-03-18).

Notes to self / scribbles:
- prioritize HF-341 canary on hosts with lower short-sequence load to reduce noise
- check PR 983 status and note any related benchmarks lost after revert
- tag related issues in Jira: JIRA-RELEASE-2145, JIRA-INC-7891
- follow up with cost team next week on cost-per-token delta alerting cadence

Next sync: 2026-03-18 10:00 PT (regular weekly)

End of notes.
